title: Revisiting Redfall after its final update reveals the ghost of the game it wanted to be
partialText: Arkane Austin's final game is still disappointing, but I'm now convinced that it could have been great.

title: How many videogame movie adaptations can you name? And, more importantly, can you remember actually liking any of them?
partialText: Our latest quiz is a bonanza for fans of Uwe Boll and Paul W. S. Anderson, which I'm assuming is a kind of person that exists.

title: This wildly ambitious modpack transforms the third-person, N64 exclusive Duke Nukem: Zero Hour into a 'jank '90s FPS' for your PC
partialText: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour Overclocked reinvigorates the console shooter with first-person perspective and mouse and keyboard controls.

title: The Razer Viper V4 Pro has reminded me that few things can beat great build quality in a mouse
partialText: Ultralight shells and analogue clicks are great, but so is build quality.

title: A character model datamined from Grand Theft Auto 5's source code 'could actually be Agent's protagonist', according to online sleuth
partialText: GTAForums user provides compelling evidence that the model is the lead character of Rockstar's cancelled spy game.

title: This 'highly realistic' city-builder could be the first real competition Cities: Skylines has seen in over a decade
partialText: Could City Masterplan do to Skylines what Skylines did to SimCity?

title: You can finally rescue Half-Life's guards and scientists thanks to this mod inspired by Lemmings
partialText: Half-Life: Lemmings lets you save the trapped employees of the Black Mesa: Facility.

title: World Championship Wrestling once spent millions on a gimmick ripping off Mortal Kombat’s Sub-Zero, before Midway threatened to sue and WCW immediately gave up: 'We were gonna lose big, like real big'
partialText: Glacier was not hot stuff.

title: All about Clint: Stardew Valley gift guide, schedule, and events
partialText: Win the blacksmith's heart.

title: Roblox unveils new Roblox Plus monthly subscription that pays creators who get players to sign up for the new Roblox Plus monthly subscription
partialText: Capturing half of the games industry's consumer sales growth apparently wasn't enough.

title: US government wants gamers to become air traffic controllers
partialText: "It's not a game," transportation secretary Sean Duffy says: "Its [sic] a career!"

title: Pete Hines says he left Bethesda because he didn't want to watch it being 'damaged' and 'abused'
partialText: Hines, Bethesda's former vice president of marketing and PR, left Bethesda in 2023, three years after it was acquired by Microsoft.

title: Former Bethesda exec thinks the studio should get more respect for the complex, open worlds it creates: 'Go try that s**t in Red Dead Redemption 2'
partialText: Despite retiring 3 years ago, Pete Hines remains one of the studio's staunchest defenders.

title: Get ready to play Overwatch's most popular maps even more in season 2 as Blizzard tweaks the voting process to prefer the majority
partialText: The new random map option could save you, but we all know it's just going to be King's Row.

title: Someone allegedly threw a Molotov cocktail at Sam Altman's house
partialText: A suspect was arrested after the early morning incident, which caused minor damage and no injuries.

title: PC Gamer's 'first can't-miss cozy game of 2026' has gone missing on Steam, and some players think Tetris is to blame
partialText: This is the second weird thing to happen to Starsand Island since it launched in February.

title: Esoteric Ebb creator reckons most players only saw half the game, and that's fine by him: 'You've got to miss stuff in order to feel like the world is bigger'
partialText: 'I write 700,000 words and then I'm expecting most of it to not be seen on a normal playthrough'

title: Amazon's Luna cloud gaming service is ending support for game purchases and subscriptions from third-party stores, and users will lose streaming access to purchased third-party games in June
partialText: Luna users' previously purchased EA, Ubisoft, and GOG games will still be accessible on their associated platforms.

title: RAM spot prices are down by 5%, though they did spike by well over 2000% this past year
partialText: Not the win you want right now.

title: Even the French government is switching to Linux now in a bid for 'digital sovereignty'
partialText: This is an attempt to "reduce the state's extra-European digital dependencies."

title: Treasure Beach is a scavenger game where you can sell what you find hidden in the sand to stingy shoppers—and let me warn you, it isn't easy
partialText: These shoppers are having me on.

title: Don't like the MacBook Neo's storage options? Well, with lots of electronics gear, years of experience, and nerves of steel, you too can have a 1 TB model
partialText: Shame you can't embiggen your own gaming SSDs like this. Or can you?

title: During a memory crisis do you really need fast memory for PC gaming? No, no you do not
partialText: Does fast DDR5 make a difference to gaming, you know what? It doesn't. Mostly.

title: Look, 16 GB of RAM is absolutely fine for PC gaming in 2026. Though there are some caveats to that...
partialText: If it's good enough for consoles, surely it's good enough for a gaming PC?

title: Mozilla says 'Microsoft goes too far' with Copilot, right before reassuring that you can turn off Firefox's 'AI enhancements'
partialText: Is AI integration really so inescapable?

title: Overwatch Sierra abilities and perks explained
partialText: Watchpoint: Grand Mesa’s Head of Security is here.

title: Keychron has shared the source files for all its keyboard and mice meaning you could almost build an entire kit from scratch
partialText: It even offers a license to sell homemade accessories you make.

title: WoW's next patch drops in just over a week, bringing a whole heap of world content and yet another gearing method from a deeply suspicious ally
partialText: I don't trust Decimus, but I like his energy.

title: Of course 1440p is your favorite gaming res, but I'm kinda stunned there are as many 4K gamers as 1080p ones in PC Gamer's ranks
partialText: Sure, 36% of you play at 2560 x 1440, but at 22% it's a straight tie between 4K and 1080p gamers in our latest poll.

title: Intel's fabs may at long last be worth all those billions of dollars
partialText: Its market capitalization is higher than it's ever been for over 25 years, thanks to recent chips and deals with Google and the Terafab project.

title: 'It stayed exactly the same': Jeff Kaplan takes us back to 2016 by confirming that Blizzard did not change the size of Tracer's butt
partialText: Now we're getting somewhere.

title: Microsoft is removing Copilot branding from Photos, Notepad, and more after promising to reduce 'unnecessary Copilot entry points'
partialText: It's better than nothing, I suppose.

title: Asus announces the ROG Equalizer: a new cable aimed at making melting GPU power connectors a thing of the past
partialText: It's even compatible with PSUs from other vendors, as long as it has a decent 12V-2x6 socket.

title: Former Bethesda artist says 'every single developer' has already brought up 95% of the complaints that made it to launch, but as Todd Howard told him, 'we can't do everything'
partialText: You can't win 'em all.

title: Framework: 'There is a very real scenario in which personal computing as we know it is dead'
partialText: The memory crisis may have a very lasting impact on the PC hardware industry.

title: Crimson Desert devs are addressing all your complaints (and then some) in a long list of planned updates, which includes adding difficulty options
partialText: That's a mighty fine list of planned changes.

title: CPUID's download page has been hacked, with its popular processor and PC info tools replaced with links to files containing malware (Update: Fixed)
partialText: Staff at CPUID have reportedly fixed the issue now.

title: The James Bond rights owners have opposed an application for a James Pond trademark
partialText: Licence to Eel. Octoguppy. I'm just brainstorming here.

title: The ill-advised business software that helped sink videogame pioneers Infocom now runs on modern PCs: 'It's a new age for aficionados of failed 1985 database products!'
partialText: The database app Cornerstone ended up being more of a cinderblock.

title: Nexon confirms reorganizaton at The First Berserker: Khazan developer but says it's merely 'a strategic reallocation of talent' as development winds down
partialText: The shuffle is "not a workforce reduction or team dissolution," Nexon says, it just needs the people elsewhere.

title: Darkstone, a classic 1999 action RPG about eating apples and trying not to die of old age, is being remastered by its original creator
partialText: Eat the apple, apple boy.

title: Nine-year-old cult visual novel Doki Doki Literature Club has been abruptly pulled from Android for its 'depiction of sensitive themes'
partialText: Doki Doki Literature Club released on Google Play in December.

title: Dune: Awakening is finally making Deep Desert and shipwreck PvP fully optional
partialText: Self-hosted servers are coming too.

title: 20 years after Kojima announced a Metal Gear Solid movie was happening, Sony announces a Metal Gear Solid movie is happening
partialText: But will it actually happen? Snake? Snake! Snaaaaaaaaaaaake!

title: World of Warcraft player housing was sorely lacking PvP so Blizzard is dropping its own version of prop hunt
partialText: Finally, a way to weaponize all those household items.

title: Facepunch boss Garry Newman shoots down Rust 2 speculation after mysterious Steam page appears: 'Nope'
partialText: I thought it might be, but it's not.

title: My first campaign in Europa Universalis 5 may have ruined the entire series for me
partialText: I have 1,700 hours in EU4—now I don't feel like I can go back, but EU5 has to change if I'm going to play it again.

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse developers are trying really, really hard to make sure you know it's a metroidvania without using the word 'metroidvania'
partialText: What is a genre, anyway, but a miserable pile of references.

title: Graveyard Keeper 2 is coming this year, and the original is free to keep on Steam if you grab it now
partialText: The sequel to the 2018 medieval cematary sim launches this year.

title: Before Imagine Dragons, brothers Dan and Mac Reynolds always wanted to make videogames—now their first, Last Flag, is about to release
partialText: They love capture the flag, so they made a game dedicated to flag hiding and flag retrieving, with inspiration from Team Fortress 2, Halo, and League of Legends.
